Task 2 VALIDATE `if grep -nE 'waitForFunction|textContent' plugins/relay/resources/auth-login.template.mjs; then ... exit 1` is an absence grep over the whole file, not diff-scoped (shape (a)). The unmodified template already contains the word in its own comment at lines 634-635 ('page.evaluate awaits a promise, whereas waitForFunction does not await an async predicate'), so the command exits 1 on a fully compliant implementation and Task 2 can never pass. Fix: scope to added lines, `git diff --unified=0 23d1774 -- plugins/relay/resources/auth-login.template.mjs | grep -E '^\+[^+]' | grep -E 'waitForFunction|textContent'` inside the if, and keep any new comment free of the word.

## Notes says "a token-only `api` role with no cookies and no browser probe cannot be proven by a state-only probe and will halt `FAILED_LOGIN_REJECTED`"; ## Acceptance Criteria says "AC-A5 (PRD AC-12): A valid session is still reused with no login" and Task 2 specifies httpProbeProof fetches only with `pw.request.newContext({ storageState: storage })`. Implementer impact: the template today accepts a token-only api session (`!hasCookies && token === null` is the only reject), so the new probe presents the session differently from the way the runner does and rejects a valid token-only session, turning AC-20 into a new false negative; the Implementer would build a probe that sends cookies only and a stop rule that merely reports the casualty. The proof must present what the session carries (storage-state cookies plus the token artifact's header and value prefix when a token exists) on the with-session side and neither on the without side, on save (in-memory token) and on reuse (token artifact). Note the api-mechanism token artifact written at the end of main carries no header or value_prefix (only static-token does), so the plan must also state where the header for an api token comes from.
